title: Blow ye Winds
transcription:
Blow Ye Winds

'Tis advertised in Boston town,
New York, and Buffalo
Ten thousand brave Americans
a-whaling for to go.

Chorus:
Singing blow ye winds in the morning
blow ye winds hi-ho
Clear away your running gear
and blow ye winds hi-ho.

They ship you to New Bedford,
the famous whaling port
They put you on a clipper ship
before you know you're out.

Chorus

And now we're out to sea, my boys,
the winds com on to blow
One half the watch is sick on deck,
the other half below.

Chorus

Our captain is a salty man,
his stern with beard of grey
He's been a whaling for to go
for many a lonesome day.

Chorus

We're up since early morning
await the whale fish blow
The harpoon strikes are clean and fast
and then she dives below.

Chorus

And now that she is ours, my boys,
we'll drag her to the side.
We'll lower down the blubber hooks
and rob her of her hide.

Chorus

And now our cruise is over,
the pay we get is grand.
We'll heave on all our stud sails
and sail for Yankee land.

Chorus
